text:
anna: Quick sync from the DR postmortem — pulled recurring cascade patterns and a concise follow-up list. Need owners + short ETAs so we can lock the next game-day rehearsal.

mike: I can own multi-region routing validation (ALB/GCLB flows). ETA: EOW for smoke tests. Will need route-table diff and traffic-shaping knobs.

sofia: I'll own backup verification & snapshot restores. Plan: full snapshot restore to staging Thu, partial restore test Fri. ETA: Fri COB with results.

raj: Taking restore runbook edits. I'll fold failed steps from the postmortem into explicit validation points. Target PR by Monday.

elena: Observed KV cache warmup causing ~30s surge after failover. Adding a pre-warm step to the runbook. ETA next Wed.

tim: I'll schedule game-day and ops rotation — propose Tue 10:00-12:00 PT. ops-bot, create poll?

ops-bot: poll created: "DR game-day rehearsal — 2hr slot (Tue)" https://calendar.internal/poll/3199990001

mike: For ALB -> regional fallback, suggestion: graceful drain + 60s grace window rather than an immediate cut. Thoughts?

sofia: Graceful drain +60s for stateful endpoints. For backups: I'll add checksum validation steps: `pg_dump --format=custom` then `pg_restore --list` verify against manifest.

anna: +1. Raj, include explicit commands & expected outputs in runbook so Sofia can reference them.

raj: Draft checklist I'll add:
1) Snapshot verify: list snapshots, check tags
2) Create test volume: `aws ec2 create-volume --snapshot-id $SNAP`
3) Attach & mount, run `sha256sum` against manifest
4) Boot test instance and run app smoke tests

elena: Adding telemetry checkpoint: flag `dr_test` metric during game-day so Optimize doesn't batch aggressively and skew latency.

tim: Who owns failover telemetry annotation? I can add dashboard tile, need someone to emit the metric during rehearsal.

mike: I'll add a temporary toggle in routing-service to emit `dr_test=true` on header-based routed traffic. PR today.

sofia: For partial restore test I need a small dataset + synthetic traffic generator. @anna can you ok a short staging infra budget (<$200)?

anna: Approved. Use billing tag `postmortem-rehearsal`. Keep it tight.

raj: I'll add rollback decision tree to the runbook with clear abort points and owner handoffs.

tim: Ops rota for game-day: anna (lead), mike (routing), sofia (data/restore), elena (runtime), raj (runbook), tim (coord).

ops-bot: calendar event created: "DR cascade rehearsal" Tue 10:00-12:00 PT, attendees: anna,mike,sofia,elena,raj,tim

mike: Will post ALB route diff + smoke script later today.

sofia: Will post restore verification script + manifest sample after snapshot run tomorrow.

anna: Everyone please update central spreadsheet (owner, ETA, acceptance criteria) by EOD: https://docs.internal/dr-rehearsal/owners

elena: Updated my line.

raj: Runbook PR target + checklist added.

mike: Routing tests scheduled Thu AM.

sofia: Snapshot restore to staging done — hit minor permission issue, fixed. Full results in thread tomorrow.

anna: Thanks team. We'll close this loop in the EOD sync and lock the game-day. If anything slips, flag here so we can re-prioritize. :thumbsup:
